# eBay Ireland

> > eBay Ireland is the Irish marketplace for buying and selling electronics, cars, fashion, collectibles, and more with integrated social login authentication.

eBay Ireland (ebay.ie) serves as the localized Irish portal of the global eBay marketplace, offering online retail across diverse product categories. The platform provides streamlined user authentication through social login integration with Google, Facebook, and Apple.

- online marketplace

## Core Marketplace

- [Electronics, Cars, Fashion, Collectibles & More | eBay](https://www.ebay.ie/): eBay Ireland homepage - online marketplace for electronics, cars & more

## User Authentication

- [Sign in or Register | eBay](http://signin.ebay.ie/): eBay user authentication with Google, Facebook & Apple login options
- [Sign in or Register | eBay](https://signin.ebay.ie/ws/eBayISAPI.dll?SignIn&sgfl=gh): eBay sign-in portal with social login integration via API endpoint
